title: Agent Skills SKILL.md Frontmatter
description: PROJECT-AUTHORED, NOT VENDORED. agentskills.io publishes no JSON Schema (see PROVENANCE.md), so this document is written by Agent Manager from the field set recorded in specs/001-agent-manager-hub/research.md R1. It is not an artefact of the Agent Skills specification and must never be presented as one. The $id host is deliberately unresolvable so nothing can mistake it for a published schema.

name.description: Skill name. The published pattern also forbids '--' and '..' anywhere in the value via a negative lookahead, which this pattern cannot express: Go's RE2 has no lookahead. That half of the rule is enforced by an explicit check in name.go and reported at this same schema path.

description.description: What the skill does and when an agent should reach for it.

allowed-tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL, and not an enforcement mechanism: the Agent Skills specification states it grants pre-approval for the listed tools but does not block others. Nothing in this hub may read it as a permission boundary.
